def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # body_mass_g: strip commas / spaces and parse to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # out-of-range body mass (e.g. 3700000 written in mg) -> rescale to grams
    mask = (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500) & (df['body_mass_g'] / 1000).between(2500, 6500)
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # flipper_length_mm: negative sign error -> absolute value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # sex label variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': None})
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
